rationale.edition: Both changed paths live under web/src/enterprise/components/billings/, which is an enterprise-owned location (the o2-enterprise repo's web layer). The billing/invoice symbol names corroborate the enterprise call, so the edition is 'enterprise'.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is user-facing (an invoice table component the user sees on the billing page), the trigger comment is empty (no opt-out), and no tests-added label was passed in.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the component now renders invoice amounts via Intl.NumberFormat currency formatting with Stripe minor-unit scaling, so the user-visible amounts (e.g. $100.00, €150.50, ¥5,000) change and must be verified against the new formatting logic.
rationale.area: The change is in enterprise billing (invoice table), which maps to the Management area where sibling enterprise specs like cipherKeys.spec.js and logoManagement.spec.js live (actual_folder Management).
rationale.group: The Management shard already runs enterprise management specs and is the closest existing group for a billing/invoice-table spec.
rationale.existing_tests: No E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/enterprise/components/billings/invoiceTable.spec.ts, a Vitest unit test, which is not Playwright E2E coverage.
